name: WhalePulse
description: Exchange net flow regime classifier with price divergence detection for BTC — delivering a conviction-scored accumulation vs distribution verdict on demand.

tools.name: get_whale_regime
tools.description: Returns BTC exchange flow regime classification — accumulation or distribution — with whale cohort delta, MVRV zone, divergence detection, conviction score, and plain English verdict.

asset.description: Asset to analyze. Default is BTC.

tools.name: get_divergence_signal
tools.description: Detects divergence between BTC price action and exchange flow direction — returns bullish or bearish signal with severity rating.

asset.description: Asset to analyze. Default is BTC.

tools.name: get_conviction_score
tools.description: Returns a 0-100 conviction score for BTC accumulation or distribution pressure with full signal breakdown showing contribution of each factor.

asset.description: Asset to analyze. Default is BTC.

must_win_prompts: Are whales accumulating or distributing BTC from exchanges this week?
What is the current BTC exchange flow regime and conviction score?
Is there a divergence between BTC price action and exchange flows right now?
Should I be concerned about distribution pressure before sizing my BTC position?
What are whale addresses doing with their BTC holdings this week?
What does the MVRV zone tell us about current BTC market conditions?
Give me a full conviction breakdown for BTC accumulation pressure today
data_sources: CoinMetrics Community API — exchange flows, MVRV, active addresses, price
bitcoin-data.com API — whale address cohort balances at 1k-10k BTC and 10k+ BTC resolution

in_v1: Whale cohort delta at 1k-10k and 10k+ BTC resolution

buyer: Retail BTC macro investor without Glassnode seat sizing a position
